{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America stands in solidarity with the people of Cuba.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America categorically opposes the U.S. economic blockade imposed on Cuba by the United States and its allies, as mandated by DSA’s 2019 Convention Resolution 62.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"U.S. political and economic policies vis-à-vis Cuba have had a devastating effect on the Cuban people.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"U.S. political and economic policies vis-à-vis Cuba have hindered the development of ties of solidarity between citizens of the United States and Cuba.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America stands opposed to U.S. imperialism.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America opposes economic sanctions or other actions that would undermine the self-determination of the Cuban people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America opposes the continued existence of the U.S. Naval Base at Guantánamo Bay.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America will work in coalition with other organizations that stand in solidarity with Cuba to achieve the goal of defending Cuba’s sovereignty.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America has always condemned the long-standing efforts by the U.S. government to undermine the stability of Cuba.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"The U.S. government’s actions toward Cuba were never designed to aid the Cuban people, but instead to appease right-wing U.S. citizens of Cuban origin and punish a country that rejected imperialism and capitalism.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America hopes that the normalization of foreign relations will curtail negative U.S. actions in the future.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"This statement was approved by DSA’s National Political Committee (NPC).",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
